paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Temporal variability of targets included in the literature. We see that there has been a gradual rise towards multi-target datasets.
model_annotation: This chart illustrates the distribution of targets conceptualized or operationalized over time. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, and the vertical axis represents a value from 0.0 to 1.0, labeled “Targets,” with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each year is represented by a stacked bar composed of five colored segments corresponding to the number of targets: blue for ‘0’, orange for ‘1’, green for ‘2-4’, red for ‘5-7’, and purple for ‘8+’, as indicated in the legend. In 2012, the bar reaches approximately 0.9, with the majority comprised of the green segment (2-4 targets) and a smaller section of blue (0 targets). In 2013 and 2014, the bars are approximately 0.8 in height, largely composed of blue (0 targets) and orange (1 targets). The bar for 2016 has a height around 0.7, with the majority of its height represented by the orange (1 targets) and green (2-4 targets) segments, and the 2017 bar has a height around 0.6. The 2022 bar reaches a height close to 1.0 with the largest portion from the green (2-4 targets) segment and notable contributions from the orange (1 targets) and purple (8+ targets) segments. The bars are ordered chronologically from left to right and no bars appear to be visually emphasized.
